findings.explanation: Contains raw template residue (`*`) and verbatim title injection in prose explanations.
findings.quote: The search scopes `scada:alarm` in `index=scada` and applies `*` to surface `NERC CIP-008 cyber incident report timeline`.
findings.suggested_fix: Explain the actual SPL filtering and timeline tracking logic for CIP-008 incident milestones instead of placeholder wildcards.

findings.explanation: Carries multi-vertical template list (EHR, POS, OSS/BSS) completely unrelated to Energy & Utilities SCADA environments.
findings.quote: Compare result counts to the source system UI (SCADA HMI, EHR interface engine, POS gateway, OSS/BSS console, etc.) for the same time range.
findings.suggested_fix: Scope validation guidance specifically to SCADA/EMS historian or incident response ticketing systems.

findings.explanation: CIP-008 governs Cyber Security Incident Response and mandatory reporting timelines (e.g. to E-ISAC / NCCIC), not dispatching utility repair crews or managing operational budgets.
findings.quote: Operations and risk leaders in Energy and Utilities use signals from NERC CIP-008 cyber incident report timeline to move crews, budget, and customer or regulator communications while the situation is still controllable
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite value proposition around meeting mandatory regulatory incident disclosure deadlines and tracking response workflow stages.

findings.explanation: Contains unedited lowercase title insertion with compliance standard jargon ('nerc cip-008').
findings.quote: We watch energy and utilities systems for signs of nerc cip-008 cyber incident report timeline so your team can act early
findings.suggested_fix: Rephrase in plain language explaining that it tracks incident response progress so required regulatory reports are filed on time.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: The `table` command requests `_time`, `alarm_id`, `priority`, and `shelved`, but all of these fields were discarded by the preceding `stats count as event_count dc(host) as distinct_assets by substation_id` command.

summary: Heavy template residue across detailed implementation and value fields, with cross-vertical boilerplate and nonsensical SPL field projections.
